_permissions_note: Reviewed baseline that must match extension/manifest.json exactly. Enforced by scripts/validate_sandbox.py. Per-permission justifications are in permission_justifications below — widening this list without a justification entry is a review failure.

activeTab.justification: Read the page the user is currently on in order to score it.

storage.justification: Persist the 24h domain cache, user settings and local scan history on-device. No remote sync.

sidePanel.justification: Render the verdict, reason codes and securities identity card.

scripting.justification: Inject content_script into WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web for message-render hooks, which activeTab alone cannot reach.

tabs.justification: Resolve the focused tab id for sidepanel/background correlation and badge updates.
tabs.review_outcome: REVIEW_PENDING — activeTab may cover the sidepanel path; dropping `tabs` would be a citable least-privilege win under CSCRF. Owner: unassigned.

alarms.justification: Schedule periodic domain-cache pruning and backend health re-checks.
alarms.review_outcome: REVIEW_PENDING — could plausibly be replaced by lazy pruning on read. Owner: unassigned.

contextMenus.justification: Provide the right-click 'Check with Phisherman AI' entry point on selections and media.

host_permissions_rationale.http://*/*, https://*/*: Read rendered website content for local checks. Default on-device mode sends no analysis requests. Remote transmission requires the enhanced mode; link expansion also requires its separate opt-in.
Live message-render hooks for the two messaging surfaces named in the requirements (CH2). Scoped explicitly rather than relying on the wildcard so the intent is auditable.
host_permissions_rationale.http://127.0.0.1:8000/*: Loopback-only backend for local development. Never an external listener.
host_permissions_rationale.https://phishermanai-1.onrender.com/*: Optional hosted backend when explicitly configured in remote mode; no longer the default.
host_permissions_rationale.https://chetana.activemirror.ai/*: Cloud fallback in remote mode only; disabled in local and local-server modes.

retention.website_feedback: Up to 100 local records; user-initiated export/submission; up to 1000 pending backend records

blocked_claims: works on native calls or messages without a companion app
fully autonomous agents with no approval
live SIM-swap detection without a carrier integration
verified caller identity without an identity rail
SEBI-approved or SEBI-registered as a claim about this tool
any assertion of synthetic origin without provenance evidence
_blocked_claims_enforcement: scripts/check_blocked_claims.py fails the build if any of these appears in user-facing copy (extension UI, i18n, README, context.md). Detection corpora under backend/data/ are deliberately out of scope: they contain scam phrases we DETECT, not claims we MAKE.
release_blockers: Production cutover requires signed production module distribution with operator-controlled key custody and rotation.
Production cutover requires explicit incident and breach response runbook ownership.
Production cutover requires a mobile-companion privacy contract before any call, SMS, or native-chat ingestion claims.
Production cutover requires extension-store policy review and dispute handling for flagged entities.
Production cutover requires encryption-at-rest for retained subscriber or evidence data outside the browser.
Production cutover requires attested app-surface policy before trusted mobile escalation can be claimed.
Production cutover requires explicit telecom-consent policy before any network-signal integration can be claimed.

analysis_modes.local: No analysis network requests; bundled reference and URL-model checks only.
analysis_modes.local-server: Configured loopback backend only. Backend inference defaults to pattern-only; SCAMGATE_MAX_TIER controls optional local/cloud inference.
analysis_modes.remote: Explicitly selected mode permits page/message text and URL transmission to the configured backend and cloud fallback.

selected_financial_verification.consent: Per-input checkbox, cleared when input changes
selected_financial_verification.modes: Disabled in local mode; loopback only in local-server mode; configured destination in remote mode
selected_financial_verification.data: Selected text with phone/email redaction; UPI handles preserved
selected_financial_verification.retention: No input body written to extension storage; verdicts in service-worker memory only
